title: UK to invest £100m in 'world first' AI Biosecurity Lab

claims.claim: İngiltere hükümeti, gelişen biyolojik tehditlere karşı savunmayı güçlendirmek amacıyla 100 milyon sterlin yatırım yaparak Ulusal Yapay Zeka Biyogüvenlik Laboratuvarı (AIBL) kuracak.

evidence.quote: The UK says it will establish a national AI Biosecurity Lab (AIBL) to help strengthen its defences against emerging biological threats.
As part of Wednesday's Budget, the government will commit Â£100m to establishing the new, "world first" institute with the support of leading AI firms.

The UK says it will establish a national AI Biosecurity Lab (AIBL) to help strengthen its defences against emerging biological threats. As part of Wednesday's Budget, the government will commit Â£100m to establishing the new, "world first" institute with the support of leading AI firms.

claims.claim: OpenAI ve Anthropic, Yapay Zeka Biyogüvenlik Laboratuvarı'nın kurulmasını desteklemek amacıyla 200 milyon sterlin değerinde yapay zeka model kredisi sağlayacak.

evidence.quote: The AI Biosecurity Lab's creation will also be supported by leading AI developers, with OpenAI and Anthropic providing Â£200m worth of AI model credits that can be spent on the use of their models.

claims.claim: Şansölyenin planları kapsamında İngiltere'nin Yapay Zeka Güvenlik Enstitüsü'ne (AISI) ek 120 milyon sterlin kaynak taahhüt edildi.

evidence.quote: The Chancellor's plans to boost AI spending will also see an additional Â£120m committed to the UK's AI Security Institute (AISI).

claims.claim: Yapay Zeka Güvenlik Enstitüsü (AISI) eski Muhafazakar hükümet tarafından 2023 yılında kuruldu.

evidence.quote: Established by the former Conservative government in 2023, the lab evaluates the risks of the most advanced and powerful models - and has been championed for its role in helping build a collaborative and open approach to AI testing.

claims.claim: Hükümet, siber savunmaları güçlendirmek için yapay zeka kullanacak Ulusal Siber Kalkan için 60 milyon sterlinlik yatırım yapacak.

evidence.quote: It will come alongside a Â£60m investment in what it coined a "National Cyber Shield" which it said would use agentic AI to boost cyber-defences

claims.claim: İngiltere, kritik altyapı ve ekonomideki siber zafiyetleri tespit etmek amacıyla Ulusal Maruziyet ve Gerçek Zamanlı Zafiyet (NERV) Merkezi'ne 70 milyon sterlin fon ayıracak.

evidence.quote: and Â£70m funding towards a National Exposure and Real-Time Vulnerability (NERV) Centre.

and Â£70m funding towards a National Exposure and Real-Time Vulnerability (NERV) Centre. This, it said, would harness AI tools to detect cyber vulnerabilities across the UK's critical infrastructure and economy.
